30280.subject: Technical Drawing
30280.question_text: Construct a perpendicular bisector to a given line segment AB of length 60 mm using only a compass and a straightedge. Label all construction lines and points clearly.
30280.explanation:
1. Draw line segment AB = 60 mm.
2. With A as center, draw an arc with radius greater than half of AB.
3. With B as center, draw another arc of the same radius to intersect the first arc at points C and D.
4. Draw a straight line through C and D. This line is the perpendicular bisector of AB.
5. Label the intersection of the bisector and AB as point M, the midpoint of AB.

30281.subject: Technical Drawing
30281.question_text: Construct a regular pentagon with each side measuring 30 mm using the general method. Show all construction lines and label the vertices A, B, C, D, and E.
30281.explanation:
1. Draw a horizontal line and mark point A.
2. From A, measure 30 mm to mark point B.
3. Using a protractor, draw a 108° angle at A and B to locate the center O of the circumscribed circle.
4. With O as center, draw the circumscribed circle passing through A and B.
5. From B, step off 30 mm arcs along the circumference to locate points C, D, and E.
6. Join the points A, B, C, D, and E to form the pentagon.

30282.subject: Technical Drawing
30282.question_text: Construct an external tangent to two given circles of diameters 40 mm and 20 mm, with their centers 60 mm apart. Show all construction lines and label the tangent points clearly.
30282.explanation:
1. Draw the two circles with centers O1 (diameter 40 mm) and O2 (diameter 20 mm), 60 mm apart.
2. Draw a line connecting O1 and O2.
3. Construct a third circle with diameter equal to the difference of the radii (10 mm) centered at O1.
4. Construct the perpendicular bisector of O1O2 and find the midpoint M.
5. With M as center, draw an arc through O1 to intersect the third circle at point P.
6. Draw line O1P and extend it to intersect the larger circle at T1.
7. Draw a line parallel to O1P from O2 to intersect the smaller circle at T2.
8. Join T1 and T2 to form the external tangent.

30283.subject: Technical Drawing
30283.question_text: Draw the front, top, and right-side views of the given isometric block (dimensions: 40 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm) in first-angle orthographic projection. Include all hidden details and label the views.
30283.explanation:
1. Front view: Draw a rectangle 40 mm (width) × 20 mm (height).
2. Top view: Draw a rectangle 40 mm (width) × 30 mm (depth) directly above the front view.
3. Right-side view: Draw a rectangle 30 mm (depth) × 20 mm (height) to the right of the front view.
4. Include hidden lines for the 20 mm height in the top view and the 30 mm depth in the front view.
5. Label the views as FRONT, TOP, and RIGHT SIDE.

30284.subject: Technical Drawing
30284.question_text: Given the front and top views of an object in first-angle projection, draw the missing right-side view. Include all hidden details and label the views.
30284.explanation:
1. Analyze the front and top views to determine the object's depth and height.
2. Project lines from the front and top views to construct the right-side view.
3. Draw the right-side view showing the depth (from top view) and height (from front view).
4. Include hidden lines for any obscured features.
5. Label the right-side view as RIGHT SIDE.

30285.subject: Technical Drawing
30285.question_text: Draw a full sectional front view of the given object (a hollow cylinder with an external flange) along the vertical plane A-A. Show all hidden details and label the section.
30285.explanation:
1. Identify the cutting plane A-A in the top view.
2. Draw the front view as a full section, showing the internal details of the hollow cylinder.
3. Hatch the cut surfaces at 45° with appropriate spacing.
4. Show the flange in the section view as a solid line.
5. Label the section as SECTION A-A.

30286.subject: Technical Drawing
30286.question_text: Draw an isometric view of a rectangular block with a circular hole (diameter 20 mm) drilled through its center. The block dimensions are 50 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm. Show all construction lines and label the isometric axes.
30286.explanation:
1. Draw the isometric axes at 30° to the horizontal.
2. Construct the rectangular block using the given dimensions (50 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm).
3. Locate the center of the top face and draw an isometric ellipse (20 mm diameter) to represent the hole.
4. Project the ellipse through the block to show the hole.
5. Label the isometric axes as X, Y, and Z.

30287.subject: Technical Drawing
30287.question_text: Develop the lateral surface of a truncated right circular cone with a base diameter of 50 mm, height 60 mm, and truncated at 30 mm from the base. Show all construction lines and label the development.
30287.explanation:
1. Draw the front view of the truncated cone.
2. Divide the base circle into 12 equal parts and project these points to the front view.
3. Calculate the slant height of the full cone using $l = \sqrt{r^2 + h^2}$.
4. Draw an arc with radius equal to the slant height.
5. Step off the 12 equal divisions along the arc to form the development.
6. Join the points to complete the lateral surface development.
7. Label the development as LATERAL SURFACE.

30288.subject: Technical Drawing
30288.question_text: Draw the line of interpenetration between a vertical cylinder (diameter 40 mm) and a horizontal cylinder (diameter 30 mm) whose axes intersect at right angles. Show all construction lines and label the intersection points.
30288.explanation:
1. Draw the front and top views of the two cylinders.
2. Divide the circumference of the horizontal cylinder into 12 equal parts in the top view.
3. Project these points to the front view.
4. Draw horizontal lines from the division points to intersect the vertical cylinder in the front view.
5. Join the intersection points to form the line of interpenetration.
6. Label the intersection points clearly.

30289.subject: Technical Drawing
30289.question_text: Fully dimension the given orthographic views of a simple bracket (front and top views) using standard dimensioning conventions. Include all necessary dimensions, tolerances, and notes.
30289.explanation:
1. Dimension the overall height, width, and depth of the bracket.
2. Dimension the hole diameter and its position from the edges.
3. Dimension the thickness of the material.
4. Include tolerances for critical dimensions (e.g., ±0.1 mm).
5. Add notes for surface finish or machining requirements if necessary.
6. Ensure dimensions are placed clearly and avoid duplication.
